game.title: 007 First Light
game.blurb: Story-driven spy action game from IO Interactive, released 2026-05-27. RAWG has no average playtime yet. Genre: Action. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.summary: Play through the story missions as a young Bond earning his 00 status.

chapters.summary: Gadgets, disarms, takedowns and creative ways to deal with enemies.

chapters.title: Collectibles
chapters.summary: Postcards, MI6 files, mementos and playing cards hidden in each mission.

chapters.title: TacSim and Clearance
chapters.summary: TacSim Operations and Escalations, plus raising your clearance level.

RAWG lists "Nintendo Switch"; StrategyWiki categorises it as Nintendo Switch 2. 18 of 37 Steam achievements are hidden story achievements.
